editorial.blurb: AJI is a sushi standout where the owner-chef and team's genuine warmth matches their meticulous attention to fresh, creatively flavored ingredients.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for omakase (15-course tasting at $165) and watch the marquee board describing each course—the chefs change their menu frequently, so you're getting something special that night.
signatureDishes: Sea bass with sea salt and lime
